richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kumbakonam

c: Kumbakonam is a temple town in the Cauvery delta, and many of the people who walk its streets and tank sides every morning are older residents. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kumbakonam for parks, schools, colleges and residential layouts. We manufacture the machines in Vasai, about 1160 km away, and bring them to Tamil Nadu by road.

The delta is hot and humid through most of the year, and it gets most of its rain from the northeast monsoon between October and December. Low, flat ground near the river channels can stay wet for a while. We plan the machines on a raised concrete base. We also suggest starting with gentle, low-impact stations, because a gym that older users find easy is a gym that gets used every day.

items.q: Which outdoor gym machines are easiest for elderly users?
items.a: Seated twisters, walkers, tai chi wheels and shoulder twirls. They move at the user's own pace, need no weights or settings, and can be used without any training.

items.q: How do I protect the gym from northeast monsoon rain?
items.a: Set the machines on a raised concrete base with a slope for drainage. After the rains, check the bolts and moving parts and clear any silt from around the footings.

items.q: Do you install outdoor gym equipment in the Thanjavur region?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from our Vasai factory by road and install through our own team or a dealer in south India, using grouting or self-standing fixing as the ground needs.
